attchmntText: Techno Electric & Engineering Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intent to place a proposal for buyback of shares'.

Members of the Exchange are hereby informed that the trading in Equity Shares of Techno Electric & Engineering Company Limited shall be suspended w.e.f. August 08, 2018 (i.e. closing hours of trading on August 07, 2018) on account of Scheme of Amalgamation of Techno Electric & Engineering Company Limited with Simran Wind Project Limited.

Techno Electric & Engineering Company Limited has informed the Exchange that Simran Wind Project Limited (Transferee Company) has fixed August 09, 2018 as the Record Date for the purpose of determining the members of the Company to whom Equity Shares of the Transferee Company will be issued and alloted in the ratio of 1:1, i.e. 1 equity share of Rs. 2/- each fully paid up for every 1 equity share of Rs. 2/- each fully paid up held in the Company, pursuant to Scheme of Amalgamation between Company with Transferee Company as sanctioned by the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) on July 20, 2018,

Techno Electric & Engineering Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Scheme of Amalgamation of Techno Electric & Engineering Company Limited ( 'Transferor Company') with Simran Wind Project Limited ( 'Transferee Company')
